description: This file defines a custom exception class NotImplementedException within the OrangeHRM installer exception namespace. It extends the built-in PHP Exception class and provides a default error message for unimplemented features.

classes.name: NotImplementedException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that a particular feature or method has not been implemented.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the exception with a default or custom message, code, and previous throwable.
